text: Christopher Ryan received a BA in English from Hobart College in 1984 and an MA and PhD in psychology from Saybrook University in San Francisco, California, twenty years later.
text_raw:
Christopher Ryan received a BA in English from Hobart College in 1984
and an MA and PhD in psychology from Saybrook University in San
Francisco, California, twenty years later.

text: He spent the intervening decades in unexpected places working at very odd jobs (e.g., gutting salmon in Alaska, teaching English to prostitutes in Bangkok and self-defense to land- reform activists in Mexico, managing commercial real estate in New York’s Diamond District, helping Spanish physicians publish their research).
text_raw:
He spent the intervening decades
in unexpected places working at very odd jobs (e.g., gutting salmon in
Alaska, teaching English to prostitutes in Bangkok and self-defense to land-
reform activists in Mexico, managing commercial real estate in New York’s
Diamond District, helping Spanish physicians publish their research).

text: Drawing upon his multicultural experience, Christopher’s doctoral research focused on trying to distinguish the human from the cultural by analyzing the prehistoric roots of human sexuality, and was guided by the world- renowned psychologist Stanley Krippner.
text_raw:
Drawing upon his multicultural experience, Christopher’s doctoral research

text: Based in Barcelona since the mid-1990s, Christopher has lectured at the University of Barcelona Medical School and consulted at various local hospitals.

text: Cacilda Jetha has an Indian face, a European education, and an African soul.

Cacilda Jetha has an Indian face, a European education, and an African

text: She was born in Mozambique to a mixed Muslim/Hindu family that had immigrated from Iran and India a few generations earlier.
text_raw:
She was born in Mozambique to a mixed Muslim/Hindu family that

text: As a child, she fled civil war to Portugal, where she received most of her education and began her medical training before returning to Mozambique in the 1980s.

text: As a young physician determined to help heal her country, Cacilda spent several years as the only physician serving some fifty thousand people in a vast rural district.

text: While there, she conducted research on the sexual behavior of rural Mozambicans in order to help develop more effective AIDS-prevention efforts.
